summary: Freight Technologies (BVI) filed a Form 6-K disclosing a securities purchase agreement to issue 1,200,000 Series C preferred shares at $1.00 per share for $1.2 million aggregate to an institutional investor in a private placement. The shares are immediately convertible into ordinary shares and carry piggy-back registration rights. The offering is for working capital, not a change-of-control or restructuring. Net proceeds are ~$1.15 million after expenses. This is a routine private placement, not a special situation.
